title: Deadly Tornado Hits Suburbs of Paris
summary: A rare tornado near Paris blew through several towns north of the capital of France, toppling cranes and killing one person.

title: Shelburne Long Term Care Workers Vote to Strike
summary: SHELBURNE, NS — Late last week, Roseway Manor long term care workers, represented by CUPE 3099, voted 100% in favour of a strike mandate citing low wages, understaffing, and lack of respect for support service workers who keep the long term care home running. “For years, the long term care sector has been struggling,” said […]
